    job.extend(scratch.dash_seams, &seams, &mut control)

        &seams,
        &mut job,
        &mut scratch,
        &mut control,

        job.capacity(cache.segments).unwrap() >= job.slice(cache.segments).unwrap().len(),

    let total = cache_view.shapes[shape.index()].segments.count
